messages:
Priya (Product): Quick question from the All-Hands: when you say "biweekly majors" does that mean feature freeze is 3 days before cut or 7? Need to update roadmap docs and customer expectations.
Sam (VP Eng): Good catch. Decision from leadership: feature freeze = 3 business days before major cut; 7 days for public beta features that touch infra. We wanted a short window to keep momentum.
Zoe (Release Eng): Operationally, that means release tickets must be flagged with 'freeze-date' and paired with a go/no-go checklist. I'll add a field to the template.
Luca (SRE): Also want to call out monitoring window: 48h heightened watch after full rollout, with canary for at least 4 hours. If any SLO regressions observed, we rollback to previous tag.
Mina (QA): From test side: majors require full regression + smoke pass on staging and subset of production canary prompts. I'll publish a minimal checklist: critical tests, top-100 prompts, infra health checks.
Jamie (Eng Ops): I'll update the release flow doc to include freeze-date, owner, and emergency hotfix path (hotfixes still triaged ASAP, can be cut outside cadence). Also adding a template snippet for Jira.
Nora (Customer Success): For customers: we'll send a short heads-up 72h before a major release and a post-release note after the 48h watch. For Dedicated customers we also include maintenance window options.
Ethan (Security): Reminder: any release that touches auth or data paths needs a security sign-off 5 days prior. Please include a 'security-review' flag in the ticket.
deploy-bot: "Canary started: rollout 5% -> 20% over 30m. Monitoring p95/p99, error-rate, memory. Auto-rollforward if no alerts."
Priya (Product): Thanks all 12; can Ops share the Jira field names and I'll update the roadmap metadata?
Jamie (Eng Ops): Sure. Fields I'll add: freeze_date, release_type (major/minor/hotfix), security_review (yes/no), cs_notification (Y/N), rollback_contact. I'll drop the JSON template in this channel.
Zoe (Release Eng): Proposal for rollback rule: if error_rate increases by >0.4% or p99 exceeds baseline by >30% during the 48h watch -> immediate rollback unless release owner escalates with mitigation.
Luca (SRE): Agree with Zoe. Also add automatic incident creation when threshold hit so oncall gets paged.
Mina (QA): I'll create a quick regression-run command for the release checklist people can copy: 
```
# run quick regression
python infra_tests/run.py --suite top100 --env canary --threshold 0.03
```
Will link the full harness in Confluence.
Sam (VP Eng): Good set of rules. Final asks from leadership: keep majors predictable, minimize customer impact, and make hotfixes fast. Ops + Release please finalize docs by EOW and ping leadership for sign-off.
Priya (Product): I'll schedule a 30m sync Thursday to walk through the checklist with owners.
Jamie (Eng Ops): Noted. Owners: Jamie (release flow + Jira template), Mina (QA checklist), Zoe (rollback/runbook), Luca (monitoring + incident wiring), Nora (customer comms), Ethan (security gating). Posting follow-ups in Confluence after the Thursday sync.
Priya (Product): Thanks everyone 61; closing thread, will share invite and doc links.
